title: denmarks orsted says commission backs uk taxation british wind farms 2026 09 11
text:
Sept 11 (Reuters) - Danish offshore wind farm developer Orsted (ORSTED.CO)
, opens new tab
 said on Friday that an advisory commission ruled its two British wind farms should be ​taxed primarily in Britain, supporting the company's position in a ‌dispute between Danish and UK tax authorities.
($1 = 6.4374 ​Danish crowns)
